title: Detailed Joker Effects 0.3.0-beta.4
body:
Fixes conditional card previews and makes native descriptions easier to read.

- Bouncing Ball and other conditional bonuses retain their trigger-specific values while inactive.
- Red No bonus is limited to pickup previews. Weapon applicability restrictions remain in effect; owned stacks keep their current totals.
- Prickly Pear shows its known flat bonus, retaliation formula and trigger condition. F7 retains full event-dependent readings.
- Native descriptions are left-aligned, wrap and scroll, and restore their original layout on unload/reload.

**Install:** download `FFWJokerInfo-0.3.0-beta.4.zip`, fully exit the game, and copy the contents of `GameRoot` into the game folder. Restart the game to load the updated Lua modules. Requires a separate UE4SS installation; baseline game 0.3.0.7 / UE4SS build 1181.

**Validation:** 26 standalone Lua test files passed, including 27,600 description scenarios across 183 card/upgrade entries. Archive contents, CRC and SHA-256 were verified against the explicit allowlist. The latest layout has offline coverage; final in-game visual confirmation remains pending.

更详细的奇术卡效果更新：修复条件加成与资源状态误报，保留不适用武器的“无加成”，精简尖刺反伤说明并修正文字对齐。F7 完整规则保持不变。

运行包、独立源码包及校验文件均已提供，仅包含本卡牌组件和必要依赖，不包含存档、日志、玩家数据、修改器或战斗统计。安装无需命令行，更新后须完全重启游戏。
